payload.body: Merged --no-ff (3a0ce10) + pushed to origin/main @ 3a0ce10. Per-record authz on object subscription snapshots + live deltas (canSubscriberReadObjectRecord + GrantStore.isEmpty short-circuit), filtered via the same decide()+relaxWithGrants pipeline as HTTP object reads. Coexists with FR-70 cascade. Merge dropped the obsolete util/server-harness.ts + the branch's stale streams-cursor.test.ts edits (superseded by the real FR-117 cursor work). Full suite green (1017 passed). Unblocks aquarius-os AQ-63.
